title: 1. Overview
paragraphs: This policy describes how ZassTech (“we”, “us” or “our”) handles information when you visit our website, contact us, or use one of the ZassTech products described here, including ZassFood, the Doctor & Patient Appointment System, and ZassMarket. Products may be operated by ZassTech or by a business customer with its own privacy notice and responsibilities. That customer’s notice may also apply.
This is a general statement of intended practices, not a promise that every described feature is available. Check the in-product notices and terms provided by the organization operating a product.

title: 2. Information we handle
paragraphs: Depending on how you interact with us, information may include contact details such as your name, email, phone and organization; enquiry or support content; account, order, booking, merchant or transaction details needed to operate a product; and basic technical data such as device, browser, security events and pages visited.

Please do not send medical records, passwords, payment card numbers or other sensitive information through this marketing website or its general contact form. Payment details, when supported, should be handled by the relevant payment provider and product operator.

title: 3. How we use information
paragraphs: We use information to respond to enquiries, provide and maintain product functions, support customers, protect accounts and services, troubleshoot, and meet legal obligations. We may use aggregated information to understand service performance and improve usability. We do not use enquiry details for unrelated marketing unless you ask us or the law permits it.

title: 4. Healthcare platform information
paragraphs: The appointment platform can help providers manage availability, bookings and related workflows, including e-prescriptions where enabled. A provider or healthcare organization typically determines why patient information is collected and how it is used. ZassTech may provide technology to that organization, but does not provide medical care, make clinical decisions, or replace the provider’s privacy notice.

Patients should share health information only through an authorized, secure product workflow and direct questions about their medical record, appointments or prescriptions to their provider. Organizations using the platform are responsible for configuring access, obtaining permissions and following applicable health-data rules.

title: 5. Sharing, retention and security
paragraphs: We may share information with vetted hosting, communications, support and infrastructure providers that help deliver a service, under arrangements intended to protect it. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect people, services or legal rights. We do not sell personal information.

We keep information for the time needed for its purpose, to meet contractual or legal requirements, and to resolve disputes. Retention varies by product and customer. We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.

title: 6. Your choices and requests
paragraphs: Depending on your location and the role of the product operator, you may be able to request access, correction, deletion or a copy of personal information, or object to certain uses. Contact the provider or merchant that manages your account first for a booking, order or health record; contact us for website enquiries or questions about our role as a service provider.
Our website may use essential storage needed to operate forms and navigation. If optional analytics or cookies are introduced, we will update this policy and provide choices required by law.

title: 7. Contact us and updates
paragraphs: Questions about this policy or a privacy request can be sent to rtwebcoder@gmail.com, or by phone at 03127449832. ZassTech is based in Pabbi, Nowshera, Pakistan. We may update this page as our services or legal requirements change; the date above shows when it was most recently revised.
